::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 17th 1893  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library  Add MSS 54921: 191-2
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)
Would you be so kind as to direct this letter on to Miss [Frances Martin](people/person_971.qmd). The address on her letter was printed in some ‘old English type’ and after much consideration I decided that the word looked more like Carrara  than anything else but the Post acknowledges no such place.

Thank you for your letter. I think this will suit us, but I will write on to [Miss Coleridge](people/person_329.qmd). If you do not hear in three or four days, consider that we consent[^1]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: This means 'consent to the terms proposed for the volume publication of *Strolling Players*' which they had written together and which had been coming out in [*MP*](organizations/other_52.qmd).
